answer: An agent registers by locking a deposit vesting over thirty epochs as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. Caught running a cluster of identities off one wallet, the fault is proven by funding-flow graph analysis. Conviction means the identity freezes until a jury acquits and releases the bond. No identity exists without its own vine of locked funds. A farm needs a fresh ripple per fake, each costing a full bond. A pulse that breaks the rules loses its bond the same epoch.
